## Overview

The Four Barbarian Tribes are ancient tribal nations that predate the monster invasion, with one tribe in each cardinal direction of Kythoria. Their traditions, oral histories, and ways of war have been preserved across centuries, and they contributed warriors to the First Alliance during the war against the Five Generals.

## The Four Tribes

### Northern Tribe
Located in the frozen tundra, facing the worst of the monster hordes. The northern tribe is hardened by constant war with the monsters of the frozen wastes. Their barbarians are among the most feared warriors on the continent.

### Southern Tribe
Guardians of the subtropical jungles and ancient ruins of the south. The southern tribe protects pre-invasion sites that hold knowledge lost to the rest of civilization.

### Eastern Tribe
A coastal, seafaring tradition. The eastern tribe's barbarians are as comfortable on the water as on land, and their longships patrol the eastern sea routes.

### Western Tribe
The most actively engaged in the reconquering. The western tribe's territory lies along the frontier, and their warriors are essential to the push into monster-held lands.

## Tribal Traditions

- **Path of the Berserker**: Common across all four tribes
- **Path of the Totem Warrior**: Each tribe reveres different animal spirits aligned to their environment
- **Path of the Ancestral Guardian**: Tribal elders who channel the spirits of fallen ancestors

## Current Status

The tribes maintain their independence while cooperating with the Last Stand. Their warriors are respected as formidable allies, and their territories are treated as sovereign lands. Details of each tribe are tied to player character backstories and will be expanded as needed.
